📖 How to use

  1. Type a song name and duration, then click "Add song".
  2. Reorder with the ↑ ↓ buttons; tick "encore" for encore songs.
  3. Watch the main-set, encore and total times update live.
  4. Copy the setlist to share it with your band.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is my setlist saved?

Yes — your setlist is saved in this browser's localStorage automatically and restored when you return.

How does the encore split work?

Tick the encore box on any song — encore songs get their own subtotal below the main set.

What duration formats work?

Type minutes:seconds (3:45) or decimal minutes (3.75) — both are understood.
